nodes.name: BurstAotSettings_StandaloneOSX.json
nodes.summary: Burst AOT compiler settings for the standalone macOS build target. Enables Burst compilation and optimisations while disabling safety checks and debug-in-all-builds, targeting 64-bit x86/ARM CPUs with optimize-for-size off.

nodes.name: BurstAotSettings_WebGL.json
nodes.summary: Burst AOT compiler settings for the WebGL build target. Enables Burst compilation and optimisations with safety checks off, but omits a CPU target list since WebGL has no specific CPU target selection.

nodes.name: CommonBurstAotSettings.json
nodes.summary: Burst AOT settings shared across all build targets: a minimal MonoBehaviour block with an empty DisabledWarnings string, meaning no Burst compiler warnings are suppressed globally.

nodes.name: ProjectVersion.txt
nodes.summary: Records the Unity Editor version the project is opened with: 6000.3.10f1 (revision e35f0c77bd8e). This pins the editor version despite the project aiming for Unity 2022.3+.

nodes.name: SceneTemplateSettings.json
nodes.summary: Scene template pin/dependency settings for the Unity Scene Template system. Registers dependency types (AnimationClip, AnimatorController, Material, Shader, Texture, SceneAsset, etc.) with default instantiation modes — assets like MonoScript, Shader, and SceneAsset default to a copy; textures and materials default to referencing the original.
